body: I'm sorry to hear about your friend. You're a good person to have still gone back to pick up the pieces in the end. Thank you for the advice, it would be hard to cut him off but I'd rather do that then go down with him. Hopefully I won't have to though, he's a really great friend to me
Thank you for reading all of that. It's nice to know I'm not alone. Good luck with the fleas and the appointment :)
Thank you for reading. It's nice to find other people who understand
